svg.aria-label: doc-style-builder: Any work product, documented one way. Seven skeletons, one house theme, PDF + DOCX from one Markdown file. Steps: Gather, the facts from the work; Ground, checked against the source; Summarize, into the right skeleton; Confirm, with the user; Build, Markdown to PDF + DOCX. Output: a matching PDF and DOCX, changes highlighted.
